task:
DO NOT USE ANY TOOLS. Do not Read/Grep/Glob/Bash. Return the final review immediately from the evidence below; this is a one-shot adversarial architecture review, not a repo exploration.

AUTHORITATIVE EVIDENCE FROM PRIMARY AUDIT OF main ef552e3bdffeadbdd662c2cd8e125165aeeed9fe:
1) CompetitionSmartHot classifies public CHANNEL/YELL/SAY competitor ads then directly calls a locally-resolved scheduleCounter. It recursively discovers scheduleCounter and findLocationsInMessage through debug.getupvalue.
2) scheduleCounter uses SS.counterAt and SS.lastCounterAt, therefore cooldown/dedupe are process-local and cannot stop 4 separate WoW clients reacting to one event. Existing counter delay is ~2-3s.
3) Core explicitly documents WoW 1.12 Lua 5.0 max 32 captured upvalues per closure and exports W112_SUMMONSCOUT_API_V1 specifically so HOT compatibility modules should avoid debug-upvalue walking. sendSpamMessage already centralizes channel resolution, same-ad dedupe and lastAdvert state, but there is not currently an explicit arbitrary-text advert API.
4) FallbackRouterHot already uses SummonScoutDB.masterName plus private SendChatMessage WHISPER packets with reserved [SSFR1] prefix, hex fields, provider HELLO every 12s. [SSFR1] is already filtered from WIM/customer transcript and guarded as internal control traffic.
5) FallbackRouterHubAckHot makes a fixed total pool sticky and refreshes F.providers entries, so F.providers is NOT a trustworthy fresh-online source by itself.
6) Packager automatically appends every TOC-declared SummonScout_*Hot.lua not specially excluded into SummonScout_WhisperConfirmSpam.lua; hard native payload cap is 262144 bytes. main was repaired today specifically for this cap and Lua 5.0 parser/local issues. Therefore a new coordinator should deliberately NOT be named *Hot.lua and should own one small stable frame rather than joining HotHost fanout.
7) Desired behavior: one competitor event -> exactly one public group response, e.g. WTS HYDRAXIS/HYJAL/WINTERSPRING/SILITHUS SUMMON 3G. Price is configured once on master GUI. Non-winning clients suppress only that event; direct customer whisper/invite/summon paths remain unchanged. Never retry/reassign after a grant because duplicate public ads are worse than missing one counter.

PROPOSED V1 FOR YOU TO CHALLENGE:
- Add cold SummonScout_FleetCounterCoordinator.lua (no *Hot suffix), stable global API W112_SUMMONSCOUT_FLEET_COUNTER_V1, one small frame for CHAT_MSG_WHISPER + OnUpdate, no debug.getupvalue and no HotHost registration.
- Reuse same masterName + WHISPER transport + [SSFR1] reserved family, but give coordinator distinct codes (FCV version/service heartbeat, FCE enabled/capability ack, FCC candidate, FCG single grant, FCA delivery ack). Do not modify FallbackRouter or trust its sticky provider table; coordinator keeps its own fresh peers from FCV heartbeats.
- Every updated summoner FCV heartbeats version + local configured service to master every ~12s. Master only advertises destinations from fresh coordinator peers plus its own local service. This also solves mixed-version rollout: followers only hand ownership to coordinator while a recent master FCE capability is present.
- CompetitionSmart makes one minimal hook after qualified classification: if coordinator.Submit(sender,message,eventType) returns true, do NOT call local scheduleCounter; otherwise preserve current legacy path. Intercept all qualified competitor ads while fleet mode is healthy, not customer whispers.
- eventId is deterministic from normalized sender + normalized message + event type, with short TTL; no timestamp. Master collects FCC candidates ~0.5-0.8s, chooses one candidate deterministically/least-recent-speaker, renders group text from fresh services and master-owned integer price, sends exactly one FCG with exact final text. Grant commits the event; no reassignment/retry even if ACK is absent.
- Winner schedules the granted text after remaining small delay then sends through a NEW explicit core API, e.g. W112_SUMMONSCOUT_API_V1.SendAdvertText(text), implemented by factoring existing sendSpamMessage internals so channel resolution/dedupe/lastAdvert accounting are not duplicated. Core OnEvent still captures EventAPI as one helper-table upvalue, so adding an API field should not add a new large dispatcher upvalue.
- Coordinator code style: one module table and methods rather than dozens of top-level local functions, to minimize Lua 5.0 locals/upvalues. Bound all peer/event tables and packet/text lengths. Accept FCV/FCC at master only from expected/known fleet peers; accept FCE/FCG at followers only from configured master.
- Master global competitor-response cooldown is authoritative. Direct customer whispers/invites/summons bypass coordinator completely. If coordinator capability is not healthy, legacy scheduleCounter remains available; immediately after losing a previously-healthy master prefer a short fail-silent grace rather than allowing all peers to stampede.

Return ONLY: (1) verdict GO / GO WITH CHANGES / NO-GO, (2) the 3 most important flaws or changes, (3) whether the explicit SendAdvertText core API is preferable to direct SendChatMessage, (4) 8 must-pass tests. Be decisive and under 700 words.
